steps.eval: (() => { const toolbar = document.querySelector('[data-settings-toolbar="true"]'); if (!toolbar) throw new Error('缺少设置搜索工具条 data-settings-toolbar'); const pos = getComputedStyle(toolbar).position; if (pos === 'sticky' || pos === 'fixed') throw new Error('搜索工具条仍在吸顶/悬浮: ' + pos); const content = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content="true"]'); const firstSection = content.querySelector('section[id^="settings-"]'); const title = firstSection.querySelector('h2'); const tb = toolbar.getBoundingClientRect(); const th = title.getBoundingClientRect(); const gap = Math.round(th.top - tb.bottom); if (gap < 0) throw new Error('搜索工具条与首个分节标题重叠 ' + (-gap) + 'px'); if (gap > 24) throw new Error('搜索工具条与首个分节间距过大 ' + gap + 'px'); const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); if (Math.round(root.scrollTop) !== 0) throw new Error('场景开始前页面不在顶部: ' + root.scrollTop); return { position: pos, toolbarBottom: Math.round(tb.bottom), firstTitleTop: Math.round(th.top), gapPx: gap }; })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); const input = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content] input[type="search"]'); const before = input.getBoundingClientRect(); root.scrollTop = 600; const after = input.getBoundingClientRect(); const ib = after; const bodies = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-body]')]; const hits = bodies.filter((b) => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return ib.bottom > r.top && ib.top < r.bottom && ib.right > r.left && ib.left < r.right }); const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-setting-label="true"]')].filter((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return ib.bottom > r.top && ib.top < r.bottom && ib.right > r.left && ib.left < r.right }); if (hits.length > 0) throw new Error('滚动后搜索框仍压在分节卡片上: ' + hits.length + ' 处'); if (labels.length > 0) throw new Error('滚动后正文文字从搜索框底下穿过: ' + labels.length + ' 处'); if (!(after.bottom < before.bottom - 500)) throw new Error('搜索框没有随内容滚动（位移 ' + Math.round(before.bottom - after.bottom) + 'px）'); return { scrolledPx: Math.round(root.scrollTop), inputBottomBefore: Math.round(before.bottom), inputBottomAfter: Math.round(after.bottom), overlapCards: hits.length, overlapLabels: labels.length }; })()

(() => { const input = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content] input[type="search"]'); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'f', code: 'KeyF', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); if (document.activeElement !== input) throw new Error('Ctrl+F 没有聚焦设置搜索框，当前焦点: ' + (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName)); const r = input.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.top < 0 || r.bottom > window.innerHeight) throw new Error('Ctrl+F 聚焦后搜索框仍在视口外: top=' + Math.round(r.top)); const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); root.scrollTop = 0; return { focused: true, inputTop: Math.round(r.top) }; })()

(() => { const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-body]')]; const report = []; for (const body of sections) { const sec = body.closest('section'); const slots = [...body.querySelectorAll('[data-setting-slot="true"]')]; const columns = new Map(); for (const slot of slots) { const r = slot.getBoundingClientRect(); const key = Math.round(r.left); if (!columns.has(key)) columns.set(key, []); columns.get(key).push(Math.round(r.right)); } for (const [left, rights] of columns) { if (rights.length < 2) continue; const spread = Math.max(...rights) - Math.min(...rights); report.push({ id: sec.id, left, n: rights.length, rights: [...new Set(rights)], spread }); } } const bad = report.filter((item) => item.spread > 1); const worst = report.reduce((max, item) => Math.max(max, item.spread), 0); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('同一列控件右缘不一致: ' + JSON.stringify(bad.slice(0, 4))); const switches = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-setting-slot] button[role="switch"]')]; const desync = switches.map((el) => { const track = el.querySelector('span[aria-hidden="true"]'); const slot = el.closest('[data-setting-slot]'); const row = el.closest('[data-setting-row]'); if (!track || !slot || !row) return null; const sr = slot.getBoundingClientRect(); const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); if (sr.width > rr.width * 0.6) return null; const tr = track.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = tr.right - sr.right; if (Math.abs(d) <= 1) return null; return { label: (row.querySelector('[data-setting-label]')?.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 16), delta: Math.round(d * 10) / 10, slotW: Math.round(sr.width), rowW: Math.round(rr.width) } }).filter(Boolean); if (desync.length > 0) throw new Error('开关轨道右缘没有贴齐控件槽右缘: ' + JSON.stringify(desync.slice(0, 4))); return { columnsChecked: report.length, worstSpreadPx: worst, switches: switches.length, switchDesync: desync.length, sample: report.slice(0, 4) }; })()

(() => { const content = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content="true"]'); const cr = content.getBoundingClientRect(); const clipped = (el) => { let n = el.parentElement; while (n && n !== content) { const cs = getComputedStyle(n); if (/auto|scroll|hidden/.test(cs.overflowX) || /auto|scroll|hidden/.test(cs.overflowY)) return true; n = n.parentElement } return false }; const over = [...content.querySelectorAll('*')].filter((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && (r.right > cr.right + 1 || r.left < cr.left - 1) && !clipped(el) }).map((el) => ({ tag: el.tagName, cls: (el.className || '').toString().slice(0, 50), right: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().right) })); const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); const nativeBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-content] input[type="checkbox"]').length; if (over.length > 0) throw new Error('内容列横向溢出: ' + JSON.stringify(over.slice(0, 5))); if (root.scrollWidth > root.clientWidth + 1) throw new Error('出现横向滚动: ' + root.scrollWidth + ' > ' + root.clientWidth); if (nativeBoxes > 0) throw new Error('设置页仍有 ' + nativeBoxes + ' 个原生复选框'); const smallSquares = [...content.querySelectorAll('input')].filter((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= 12 && r.width <= 18 && r.height >= 12 && r.height <= 18 }).length; if (smallSquares > 0) throw new Error('仍有 14–16px 的方形勾选控件: ' + smallSquares); return { contentWidth: Math.round(cr.width), overflowing: over.length, nativeCheckboxes: nativeBoxes, rootScrollW: root.scrollWidth, rootClientW: root.clientWidth }; })()

(() => { const content = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content="true"]'); const cr = content.getBoundingClientRect(); const cols = [...content.querySelectorAll('[data-column-row]')]; if (cols.length === 0) throw new Error('缺少列表列管理行'); const toggleOf = (row) => row.matches('[role="checkbox"]') ? row : row.querySelector('[role="checkbox"]'); const toggles = cols.map(toggleOf); if (toggles.some((el) => !el)) throw new Error('列管理行缺少 role=checkbox 的整行切换'); const on = cols.filter((row) => toggleOf(row).getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'); const tinted = on.filter((row) => { const bg = getComputedStyle(row).backgroundColor; return bg !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && bg !== 'transparent' }); if (on.length > 0 && tinted.length !== on.length) throw new Error('选中的列行没有整行着色: ' + tinted.length + '/' + on.length); const bar = on.length > 0 ? on[0].querySelector('span[aria-hidden="true"]') : null; const barW = bar ? Math.round(bar.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null; if (on.length > 0 && barW !== 3) throw new Error('选中行左侧竖条宽度不是 3px: ' + barW); const rowParentRight = cols[0].parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().right - (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(cols[0].parentElement).paddingRight) || 0); const maxRowRight = Math.max(...cols.map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().right)); if (Math.abs(Math.round(maxRowRight) - Math.round(rowParentRight)) > 1) throw new Error('列管理行没有铺满容器右缘: ' + Math.round(maxRowRight) + ' vs ' + Math.round(rowParentRight)); return { columnRows: cols.length, checkedRows: on.length, tintedRows: tinted.length, barWidth: barW }; })()
